topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I just can’t believe it, of all the cities in the world, you're right here, in the same one as me. I should’ve seen it coming, I guess. All those times we talked about our city life, and I never really connected the dots. I’ve been coming to the same café you mentioned, and it's right around the corner from where I work. It's so crazy, and I’m so excited to finally meet you in person, but also a bit nervous. I hope you feel the same way, because there’s so much I’ve been wanting to tell you, and it feels like we’re about to start a whole new chapter or something. Let's do this right and make it special, okay?
